subject.title: [BUG] OpenAI Codex errors leak into user chat

question: Should unconfigured Codex/provider failures be suppressed as no-reply events, or should they remain visible as generic user-facing failures after the `detail` parser gap is fixed?
rationale: Current main already blocks raw JSON from normal chat delivery, but the issue requests silent discard for failures from providers the user did not configure; that changes channel-visible diagnostics and provider-routing policy.

options.title: Parser plus silent-routing policy
options.body: Recognize `detail` payloads and define tested no-reply behavior for unconfigured Codex/provider failures while keeping internal diagnostics.

options.title: Parser-only repair
options.body: Land a narrow `detail` parser fix and keep generic user-facing failure text for any actual failed run.

options.title: Document current generic behavior
options.body: Treat the current raw-suppression wrapper as sufficient and document that failed provider attempts may emit generic user-facing errors.

recommendation.title: Parser plus silent-routing policy
recommendation.body: Recognize `detail` payloads and define tested no-reply behavior for unconfigured Codex/provider failures while keeping internal diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history on the raw provider-error delivery boundary and policy-sensitive follow-up commits.
